# Aunt Euphemia

## Overview

- **Age:** Elderly  <sub>[v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- **Role:** Housekeeper for students at Tabby's Place  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- **Titles:** Aunt Phemie  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunt Phemie  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>

## Appearance

She is small and elderly, with a gently triangular face and large, tender blue eyes full of youthfulness. Her cheeks are rose-colored, and her silver-white hair is styled in small rolls above her ears. She dresses in an outmoded style.

_Sources: [v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052), [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)_

## Personality

Aunt Euphemia is warm, indulgent, and cheerful, maintaining a youthful spirit and an open heart despite her old-fashioned views. She refuses to overly supervise the young women under her care, choosing instead to let them govern themselves. She harbors a fondness for cats and displays an indulgent, humorous attitude toward romance, frequently reminiscing about her past and present suitors.

_Sources: [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c16 P64](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0064), [v3 c18 P1](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0001), [v3 c35 P21](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0021), [v3 c35 P23](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0023), [v3 c25 P10](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0010)_

## Abilities

- Knitting  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c25 P2](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0002)</sub>

## Goals

- To keep a comfortable house for the girls and provide companionship  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c18 P1](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0001)</sub>

## History

After her only daughter married and left for the mission field, Aunt Euphemia was left alone in a large house until Mabel Colby invited her to relocate to Portmaris/Wexcombe to keep house for Mabel, Nell, Honora, and Cressy at Tabby's Place. Upon moving in, she brought along her two cats, the Sarah-cat and Joseph. During the Christmas break, she chose to stay behind at Tabby's Place to care for the cats and keep the house warm rather than leave them alone. Throughout their years at college, she provided a warm, welcoming presence for the girls and their visiting friends, while gently offering her perspectives on young suitors and life.

_Sources: [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c16 P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), [v3 c16 P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), [v3 c18 P1](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0001), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012), [v3 c35 P23](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0023), [v3 c35 P25](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0025)_

## Background by volume

- Given the official name Jamesina because her father James drowned a month before her birth  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- Had a single daughter who married and moved to the foreign mission field  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- Raised in a family of about six girls  <sub>[v3 c19 P42](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0042)</sub>
- courted by numerous suitors including Saul Elwood, Dan Winston, Milton Edwards, and Horatio Reeve  <sub>[v3 c35 P25](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0025)</sub>

## Quotes

> Fresh footwear looks finer than worn footwear, yet the worn footwear feels more pleasant. I have reached an age where I can pamper myself regarding footwear and views.  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)</sub>

> The drowning of kittens is a necessity, I acknowledge, or else the earth would become overcrowded. However, no respectable, fully grown cat ought to be killed—except if he consumes eggs.  <sub>[v3 c16 P69](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0069)</sub>

> You young people shouldn’t assume that all the world's romance belongs to you.  <sub>[v3 c35 P23](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0023)</sub>

> Once your soul is afflicted with rheumatism, you may as well proceed to select your coffin.  <sub>[v3 c25 P10](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0010)</sub>
